title: Hand-Over Route and Return Labor — PAP Therapy Equipment
content:
# Hand-Over Route and Return Labor — PAP Therapy Equipment

**Note.** The labor booked on the return inspection of a self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment unit that comes back to Summit Ridge on a completed return pickup request follows how the unit was handed over at delivery:

- a unit **shipped for a virtual setup** adds **1 labor unit** for the transit check of a shipped unit;
- a unit **set up in the patient's home** adds **2 labor units** to clear the settings the therapist configured;
- a unit handed over any other way adds none.

**Where the hand-over is read.** The hand-over is the delivery mode on the delivery recorded in the device's service history — virtual setup, in-home setup, branch setup or courier; where more than one delivery is recorded, the latest delivery's mode is the one read. Labor units are 15-minute units.

| Hand-over at delivery | Labor units added |
|---|---|
| virtual setup (unit shipped) | 1 |
| in-home setup | 2 |
| branch setup | 0 |
| courier | 0 |

**Cases (hypothetical).** A CPAP Fixed-Pressure System (E0601) bought outright and handed over at the branch adds nothing; the same class shipped for a virtual setup adds 1 labor unit. A Bilevel PAP Spontaneous-Timed System (E0471) set up in the home adds 2 labor units.
